name: colorblind-light
about: For a light terminal, measured against #fbfbfb. Same rule as its dark twin and the same shared vocabulary — `string`, `number` and `function` are the same colours as `ok`, `warn` and `err`, so the status triple inherits the separation proved for the source six. A near-white ground is the harder of the two cases: it squeezes every legible colour into a narrow band of lightness, and both of this file's odd-looking choices come from that. `warn` is a dark umber because err and warn collapse onto one colour under deuteranopia and only lightness could separate them; `comment` is darker than a comment ought to be because a desaturated grey and a mid green also collapse under deuteranopia, and darker was the only direction left. Worst separation over normal vision and all three simulations is dE*ab 26.
